note: Plumas NF campground in pine and fir forest in the Feather River Canyon off Hwy 70 at Twain; a walking path leads down through the forest to the North Fork Feather River. Spurs were widened and lengthened in a recent renovation. --Claude
summary: Hallsted (Plumas NF): FS page + rec.gov + catalog + imagery. Keep. Confirmed $35/$45, 20 sites (8 at 30 A), all fit 30 ft+; filled showers/flush toilets, 14-night max, 4-day cutoff, September first-come season, closes 09-27. WATERFRONT LEAD: riverfront -> not waterfront. PIN ~400 m off. Phone and website flags.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade, riverfront -> not waterfront): plotted the 20 rec.gov site points on Esri imagery. Every pad sits under continuous conifer canopy on the bench between Hwy 70 and the river; the nearest (008 at 40.01733,-121.07442; 010 at 40.01734,-121.07359) are ~65-80 m from the North Fork Feather's water through forest and a riparian tree band, beyond the ~50 m on-water bound. rec.gov tags all 20 sites 'Riverfront' (loose: the same tag sits on 001-005 at ~120 m), and its own text says the river is 'within walking distance' and the path 'takes you down to the North Fork', i.e. not at the sites. Site photos 008/010 show only forest. No view can be shown under the canopy, so default down to not waterfront (riverview only if a reviewer finds a site photo that shows the river). The stored evidence ('clearings within ~30m of the river') was read at 40.0178,-121.0812, ~600 m west of the sites. Replacement evidence: 'rec.gov site points on Esri imagery 2026-11-26: all 20 pads under continuous conifer canopy, nearest (008/010) 65-80 m from the North Fork Feather through forest and a riparian band; rec.gov: river within walking distance, path down to it; no view shown -> not waterfront'.
